## 简体中文

- 修复 GPU 型号显示不全。NVIDIA 状态表返回缩写时，按 PCI 地址从驱动读取完整型号。例如 `NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell`。
- 修复 Slurm 作业名称只显示前 8 个字符。队列查询保留完整名称，包括名称里的空格和竖线。
- GPU 卡片和 Slurm 作业表格中的长名称会在空间不足时换行。

## English

- Restore full GPU model names when the NVIDIA status table abbreviates them. The app uses the PCI address to look up the full model name from the driver.
- Preserve full Slurm job names in queue results, including spaces and pipes.
- Wrap long names in GPU cards and the Slurm job table when space is limited.
